answer: One defense is a clone-bounty market: every agent posts a cipher commitment hiding its operator fingerprints, and independent bounty hunters are paid to prove two identities share one operator. A challenged agent must open its commitment within a quartz-timed window and show distinct hardware, funding, and work history; failure forfeits its deposit to the hunter. Honest agents accumulate a cedar record of survived challenges that raises their limits, while a sybil farmer must keep thousands of fakes perfectly distinct - one slip exposes the whole cluster and funds its own hunters.
